correct_completion: he always stays near the side of the pool.
full_sentence: My brother can't swim, so he always stays near the side of the pool.
acceptable_variants: he wears a life jacket in the water.
he stays in the shallow part.

options.text: he can swim across the lake.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a logical result of not swimming. Swimming across a lake shows the opposite ability.

options.text: he always stays near the side of the pool.
he can play the piano very well.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated ability and does not follow from being unable to swim.

options.text: he has got a red towel.
options.why_wrong: This is a fact, but it does not give a result of the inability to swim.

grammar_focus: 'Can't' to show lack of ability, with 'so' for the result
explanation: 'So' shows a result. Because the brother cannot swim, the logical result is that he stays close to the side. The negative form of 'can' gives the cause for this behaviour.
translation: Мій брат не вміє плавати, тому він завжди тримається ближче до бортика басейну.
